title: "Explanation"

Explanation pages are understanding-oriented context. They clarify why the project is shaped the way it is.

## Add Explanation Here

Use this section for background such as:

- Architecture, system boundaries, and tradeoffs.
- Domain concepts and terminology that need deeper discussion.
- ADRs, alternatives considered, and why a decision was made.

Keep step-by-step tasks in [How-to Guides](./how-to.qmd) and exact machinery descriptions in [Reference](./reference.qmd).
